overview:
The **Liberation of Sullust** (4 ABY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Galactic Civil War**, fought on or above **Sullust**. New republic commandos and sullustan resistance fighters seizing imperial factory districts after endor while star destroyer debris still burns in orbit.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Galactic Civil War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Liberation of Sullust within the broader **Galactic Civil War** campaign. Front-line reports describe new republic commandos and sullustan resistance fighters seizing imperial factory districts after endor while star destroyer debris still burns in orbit.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **4 ABY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Galactic Civil War.
significance: The Liberation of Sullust illustrates how the Galactic Civil War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
